//===== rAthena Script =======================================
//= Testador de Visuais - SO GM
//===== Descricao: ===========================================
//= GERADO por docs/gerar-visuais.py. NAO EDITE A MAO.
//=
//= A planilha docs/_visuais.tsv diz se o traje PODE entrar
//= (db + texto + sprite). So o olho diz se ficou bom - e para
//= isso que este NPC existe: pagina a lista, entrega o item e
//= veste na hora.
//=
//= Sao 1419 visuais, os de veredito PRONTO.
//=
//= Fica no ar so enquanto a validacao estiver rolando. Depois
//= e so comentar a linha em npc/scripts_custom.conf.
//============================================================

prontera,144,187,4	script	Testador de Visuais	123,{
	if (getgroupid() < 99) {
		mes "[Testador de Visuais]";
		mes "Isto e ferramenta de administracao.";
		close;
	}
	.@por_pagina = 10;
	.@total = getarraysize(.Ids);

L_Pagina:
	.@ini = @visual_pag * .@por_pagina;
	if (.@ini >= .@total) {
		@visual_pag = 0;
		.@ini = 0;
	}
	mes "[Testador de Visuais]";
	mes "Pagina ^0000FF" + (@visual_pag + 1) + "^000000 de ^0000FF"
		+ ((.@total - 1) / .@por_pagina + 1) + "^000000  ("
		+ .@total + " visuais)";
	mes " ";

	.@menu$ = "";
	.@n = 0;
	for (.@i = .@ini; .@i < .@ini + .@por_pagina && .@i < .@total; .@i++) {
		mes "  " + (.@i + 1) + ". " + mesitemlink(.Ids[.@i]);
		.@menu$ += getitemname(.Ids[.@i]) + ":";
		.@lista[.@n] = .Ids[.@i];
		.@n++;
	}
	next;

	.@sel = select(.@menu$ + "^777777Proxima pagina^000000:"
		+ "^777777Pagina anterior^000000:"
		+ "^777777Ir para a pagina...^000000:Sair") - 1;

	if (.@sel == .@n) {			// proxima
		@visual_pag++;
		goto L_Pagina;
	}
	if (.@sel == .@n + 1) {		// anterior
		if (@visual_pag > 0)
			@visual_pag--;
		goto L_Pagina;
	}
	if (.@sel == .@n + 2) {		// ir para
		mes "[Testador de Visuais]";
		mes "Qual pagina?";
		input .@p, 1, ((.@total - 1) / .@por_pagina + 1);
		@visual_pag = .@p - 1;
		goto L_Pagina;
	}
	if (.@sel < 0 || .@sel >= .@n) {
		close;
	}

	.@id = .@lista[.@sel];
	if (countitem(.@id) < 1)
		getitem .@id, 1;
	equip .@id;
	mes "[Testador de Visuais]";
	mes "Vestido: " + mesitemlink(.@id) + "  (ID " + .@id + ")";
	mes "Se ficou errado, anote o ID na coluna veredito do";
	mes "docs/_visuais.tsv.";
	next;
	goto L_Pagina;

OnInit:
	setarray .Ids[0],5912,15825,15838,15840,15841,15842,15851,15858,15875,15888,15889,15905,15952,15953,15954,18740,19288,19289,19290,19291,19292,19293,19294,19424,19459,19464,19466,19472,19509,19510,19511,19512,19513,19514,19515,19516,19517,19518,19519,19520,19521,19522,19525,19526,19527,19528,19529,19532,19533,19534,19535,19536,19537,19538,19540,19541,19542,19543,19544,19545,19546,19547,19548,19549,19550,19551,19552,19553,19554,19555,19566,19573,19574,19575,19577,19581,19582,19583,19584,19585,19587,19589,19590,19597,19598,19599,19600,19601,19605,19606,19607,19608,19612,19617,19618,19621,19623,19625,19627,19629;
	setarray .Ids[100],19630,19634,19636,19643,19649,19650,19652,19653,19654,19655,19656,19657,19658,19659,19660,19661,19666,19667,19668,19669,19670,19671,19673,19676,19677,19678,19679,19680,19681,19682,19683,19684,19685,19686,19687,19690,19691,19693,19697,19701,19702,19703,19707,19709,19710,19712,19713,19715,19718,19722,19723,19724,19726,19727,19728,19729,19739,19744,19745,19746,19748,19749,19750,19751,19752,19753,19756,19758,19759,19760,19761,19762,19767,19768,19769,19770,19771,19772,19773,19774,19775,19776,19777,19778,19780,19781,19783,19785,19787,19789,19790,19800,19801,19802,19803,19804,19805,19806,19807,19809;
